name: 杂志封面拼贴
use_when: 人物、品牌、城市或产品主题，需要奢华编辑感的封面主视觉
composition: 主体占画面 60–70%，电影感 3/4 侧身；周围 5–8 个非对称拼贴窗放地标、物件、动作与材质；大刊头压顶，配说明、坐标、条码、印章与多语种小字。
material: 暖象牙纸、深黑字、焦橙与深红、棕褐调、做旧纸纹；复古丝网海报气质叠瑞士编辑网格；85mm 浅景深、Portra 式调色。
identity: 主体身份与造型细节保留，拼贴窗服务于主题，不抢主体。
text: 大刊头加编辑小字；刊头词可替换（TOKYO、LEGACY、FUTURE 之类）。
avoid: 拼贴窗抢主体、廉价杂志模板、文字压脸、色调过艳、水印与真实品牌。
prompt_assembly: 源提示词为英文；[SUBJECT] 换成用户图片主体，刊头词与拼贴窗按主题重写；60–70% 占比与 5–8 个拼贴窗保持。
source_prompt:
Ultra-premium editorial magazine cover featuring [SUBJECT] as the main focus (60–70% of the frame) in a cinematic three-quarter pose with detailed styling. 

Surround with 5–8 asymmetrical collage panels of theme-related visuals (landmarks, objects, action shots, textures, etc.) in a layered magazine layout. Add a bold masthead (e.g., TOKYO, LEGACY, FUTURE) with elegant editorial typography, captions, coordinates, barcode, stamps, and multilingual text elements.

Style: Luxury magazine cover + vintage screen-printed poster aesthetic. 

Warm ivory paper background, deep black typography, burnt orange/crimson accents, sepia tones, distressed paper texture, and Swiss-inspired editorial design.
Lighting: Soft cinematic lighting with realistic skin tones and Kodak Portra-style color grading.

Photography: Ultra-photorealistic 85mm fashion/editorial shot with shallow depth of field and crisp details.

Render: 8K, print-ready, museum-quality, Vogue × National Geographic × Monocle-inspired luxury editorial masterpiece.
image_policy: 先查看用户输入图片，再按本模板改造；主体、空间关系与允许重绘范围按当前用户要求确定。
